policy.scope: The 37 source records declared by references/candidate-manifest.json. This is a bounded candidate inventory, not an exhaustive statement of Austrian law or practice.
policy.retrieval: Use only the official URLs and hosts in the manifest. Make ordinary public HTTPS requests to one record at a time. Do not use RIS OGD/API, registration, parallel requests, authentication, browser challenge bypass, or undocumented bulk exports. If OGD is introduced later, first follow the current RIS OGD FAQ notice, timing, rate, and attribution requirements.
policy.change_handling: Keep the last reviewed/accepted source unchanged. Any new bytes or changed publisher identity create a candidate for human review. A retrieval failure, redirect outside an allowlisted official host, missing identity marker, or unexpected media type is a failed observation; it does not replace the prior candidate.
policy.reuse: Check the publisher terms recorded for each source before redistribution. RIS OGD data attribution is CC BY 4.0 when that route is used; these rules currently use the public RIS web application and linked attachments.
policy.cadence: The GitHub Actions Austria source monitor checks the fixed manifest monthly and can be run manually. It stages changed captures and derived candidates for human review; it does not update accepted/current candidates. Broad case-law discovery, mission-page discovery, and Land-practice discovery remain manual until explicitly automated.

rules.applies_to: RIS consolidated national legislation pages other than linked PDF annexes.

retrieval.entry_point: Stable RIS current-section URL from the manifest, built from Gesetzesnummer plus Paragraf or Anlage.
identity_checks: Confirm RIS is the final HTTPS host.
Confirm statute number and requested paragraph/annex on the page.
Record current title, version/effective date, last-update date, Dokumentnummer and ELI where provided.
For consolidated law, follow the current-version route, not a pinned historic ELI.
retrieval.change_signal: Compare source SHA-256 and RIS version/date metadata; a changed current text or metadata becomes a review candidate.

validation: Require the requested section identity.
Require non-empty operative text.
Retain source and converted-output SHA-256 separately.
Replay only from saved raw HTML; do not promote on conversion alone.

rules.sustainability: Conditionally sustainable for a small fixed section list using the stable current-section URLs and ordinary serial page retrieval. The HTML selector is publisher-specific and undocumented, so layout drift requires review.

rules.applies_to: RIS LVwG, BVwG and VwGH decision records.

retrieval.entry_point: Exact RIS decision URL and Dokumentnummer/case identifier in the manifest.
identity_checks: Confirm court, decision date, case number and RIS Dokumentnummer.
Keep each decision as its own record; do not treat search results or a sample as comprehensive case-law coverage.
retrieval.change_signal: The stable decision record is checked for replacement, correction, or metadata/body changes; any change is reviewed as a new candidate.

conversion.selector: Use div.contentBlock where recorded; where the saved capture has no validated selector, retain raw HTML and require human extraction review.
validation: Preserve court, date, case number and ECLI/Dokumentnummer.
Do not infer a general rule from an individual decision.
Hash the page and candidate separately.

rules.sustainability: The monitor checks the five exact records monthly and stages changed pages for review. The Austria-specific query families and cross-court filters are documented in coverage-register.md, but result discovery and screening across BVwG, VwGH and all nine LVwG collections remain manual.

rules.applies_to: Official BMEIA and oesterreich.gv.at guidance pages.

retrieval.entry_point: Stable official page ID or canonical URL in the manifest.
identity_checks: Confirm official host, exact page heading, language and visible update date if present.
Record links to forms, local authority pages and mission instructions separately.
retrieval.change_signal: Compare the source hash and visible page date; inspect changes in operative text and attachments separately from navigation changes.

conversion.selector: No shared selector is verified across these publishers; review the rendered main content and linked documents manually. Existing body-based candidates are legacy conversions, not a validated main-content extraction rule.
validation: Keep navigation/chrome changes distinct from substantive text changes.
Record the exact heading and source URL.
Stage changed text for review; do not auto-accept.

rules.sustainability: The monitor checks fixed manifest pages monthly and stages changed pages for review. Human review of main text, linked forms and authority routes remains required; mission-level discovery is outside the fixed manifest.

rules.applies_to: Official DSB and Volksanwaltschaft complaint/oversight pages.

retrieval.entry_point: Official complaint page URL in the manifest.
identity_checks: Confirm agency host and page heading.
Check complaint route, form links, jurisdiction wording and page date.
retrieval.change_signal: Review forms and route links independently from page-shell changes.

conversion.selector: Human-reviewed main content; current body selector is not treated as a stable rule.
validation: Preserve distinctions between complaint, advice, oversight and judicial remedy.
Record linked forms and submission routes.

rules.sustainability: Manual and conditional. Page links and forms can change independently; holder-specific jurisdiction coverage is open.

rules.applies_to: Official oesterreich.gv.at topic indexes used to find detailed guidance pages.

retrieval.entry_point: Stable official topic-index page in the manifest.
identity_checks: Confirm official host, page heading, visible update date and linked detail pages.
Treat it as a discovery index, not a legal text.
retrieval.change_signal: A changed page hash, page date or detail-page link set triggers manual review.

conversion.selector: Human-reviewed headings and target links; current body extraction is not a verified main-content rule.
validation: Record the exact target links and page date.
Follow changed links to the official substantive pages before updating coverage.

rules.sustainability: Sustainable as a manual monthly discovery route while the official index remains available; it does not monitor every linked page.

retrieval.entry_point: Official BMEIA directory URL in the manifest.
identity_checks: Confirm directory heading and visible as-of date.
Track consular district, representation status, visa-issuance limits and onward links.
retrieval.change_signal: A new as-of date or changed mission/district record triggers a location-specific review.

conversion.selector: Human-reviewed directory entries; treat the page as a discovery/routing source, not a legal text.
validation: Capture the as-of date and relevant row/link.
Follow each mission link before reporting local requirements.

rules.sustainability: The fixed BMEIA directory page is checked monthly for change and identity, and changed captures are staged for review. Following the current directory entries to mission-specific pages remains a separate location-dependent discovery task.

rules.applies_to: RIS NAG-DV Annex E and Annex F PDF forms.

retrieval.entry_point: Open the current RIS annex landing page from the manifest and resolve its currently linked PDF; do not rely solely on a copied download URL.
identity_checks: Confirm annex number and label E/F.
Confirm RIS Dokumentnummer NOR40221013/NOR40221015 and official RIS host.
Require PDF media type and %PDF signature.
Record exact bytes, SHA-256, page count and available document metadata.
retrieval.change_signal: A changed landing-page attachment, document number, annex label or PDF hash triggers a review candidate.

conversion.method: Retain the native accessible AcroForm PDF. Do not flatten or treat text-layer extraction as the form content; store any later transcription as a separate derivative with provenance.
validation: Check PDF signature and SHA-256.
Check document is readable and the expected annex label is present.
Do not promote a derivative without visual/form-field review.

rules.sustainability: Sustainable as a low-volume native-document rule while the current RIS landing page resolves the expected attachment; no text conversion is required.

rules.applies_to: Austria references to German-language shared EU and CJEU material.

retrieval.entry_point: source-library/shared-core-index-DE.json, one library-level index of official German-language URLs keyed by shared source ID.
identity_checks: Confirm source ID and CELEX/ELI identity before use.
Check individual language availability; an official URL pattern alone does not prove that a translated decision exists.
retrieval.change_signal: Re-resolve moved official pages from stable CELEX/ELI identity. Update the central language index once; countries reference it by index and source ID.

conversion.method: No conversion is performed while the representation is external-only. If a German file is acquired and reviewed, store one canonical copy under source-library/core/de/ and update the shared index.
validation: Keep canonical_path null for external-only entries.
Do not create country/core/ placeholders, copies or symlinks.

rules.sustainability: The reference mechanism is sustainable. The 69 German URLs are external-only and individual translation availability is unverified; this is not a mirrored German corpus.

rules.applies_to: N-Lex Austria navigation page; a discovery surface outside the 37 captured national-source candidates.

retrieval.entry_point: N-Lex Austria country page linked from the official N-Lex language index.
identity_checks: Confirm the country is Austria.
Confirm the direct RIS/Federal Law Gazette link and separate EUR-Lex links for national transposition and case-law.
Use linked publisher records for substantive text.
retrieval.change_signal: Recheck the link targets when the N-Lex page changes or a RIS/EUR-Lex route fails. Record portal errors as discovery-channel failures, not as absence of Austrian law.

conversion.method: Keep a dated link/role reference only; do not convert N-Lex navigation or XML-error fragments into national-law text.
validation: Ensure authoritative text is retrieved from RIS or EUR-Lex.
Keep N-Lex separate from official publisher host allowlists.

rules.sustainability: Sustainable as a low-cost discovery and link-repair route. It is not a national-law content source and its informational panel can fail independently.

discovery_surfaces.use: Find or re-resolve the Austrian official legal database and EUR-Lex transposition/case-law entry points. Do not cite N-Lex as the publisher of Austrian law.

monitor.scope: Only the fixed records in references/candidate-manifest.json; no broad RIS search, mission-page discovery, or Land-practice discovery.
monitor.change_output: Changed raw captures and derived review candidates are staged under source-library/austria/pending-updates/ and proposed through a pull request. The workflow never accepts or overwrites candidate content.
monitor.network: Ordinary serial HTTPS GETs to manifest allowlisted official hosts; no RIS OGD/API, authentication, challenge bypass, or parallel retrieval.
monitor.activation: The workflow must be merged to the repository default branch. Repository Actions settings must allow GITHUB_TOKEN to create pull requests.

selectors.at-bmeia-representation-directory: filtered body fallback; human review remains mandatory
